newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Decatur, Ala..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Decatur, Ala..

text.p: The CITY OF DECATUR, ALABAMA, is inviting sealed bids for the purchase from it of the Warrants referred to above (the Warrants''), such sealed bids to be opened at the City Hall in Decatur, Alabama, at 11:00 o'clock, A.M., Central Daylight Time, on Tuesday,

The above-mentioned General Obligation Warrants ( the New Money Warrants'') will be issued in two series designated School Series 1997 and Municipal Capital Improvements Series 1997, in the principal amounts of $7,965,000 and $9,695,000, respectively, and will be subject to separate redemption prior to their respective maturities, all as specified in the Official Invitation for Bids hereinafter referred to. The above-mentioned General Obligation Refunding Warrants (the Refunding Warrants'') will be issued in three series designated Series 1997-A, Series 1997-B and Series 1997-C, in the principal amounts of $7,370,000, $3,975,000 and $2,170,000, respectively. The said Series 1997-A Warrants and Series 1997-B Warrants will be subject to separate redemption prior to their respective maturities, all as specified in the aforesaid Official Invitation for Bids. The said Series 1997-C Warrants will not be subject to
redemption prior to their respective maturities. The
Warrants will be general obligations of the City.

Although the City is offering the New Money Warrants and the Refunding Warrants for sale, it reserves the right to sell and award only the New Money Warrants, and to determine not to sell or award the Refunding Warrants. However, no bid that does not offer to purchase all five series of the Warrants will be considered. The Warrants (or those thereof that the City determines to sell) will be sold and awarded in accordance with the terms and provisions of the Official Invitation for Bids. The City will furnish to the successful bidder, without cost, the printed Warrants and the approving legal opinions of Messrs. Lange, Simpson, Robinson &
Somerville, Birmingham, Alabama, Bond Counsel, with respect to the New Money Warrants and the Refunding Warrants.

The New Money Warrants and the Refunding Warrants are being offered by separate Official Statements, A copy of (i) each of the Preliminary Official Statements pertaining to the New Money Warrants and the Refunding Warrants, each including the Official Invitation for Bids and the bid form respecting the Warrants, and (ii) each of the ordinances under which the New Money Warrants and the Refunding Warrants are respectively to be authorized to be issued (each such ordinance including, among other things, certain

covenants and agreements on the part of the City respect to the continuing disclosure, subsequent to the issuance of the Warrants, of certain information and notices of certain material or other events), may be obtained from the City's financial advisor, Joe Jolly & Co., Inc., 520 First Alabama Bank Building, Birmingham, Alabama 35203, telephone (205) 252-2105.
